I am very disappointed with the way my dog’s urgent medical situation was handled by the clinic’s front desk staff.

My 7-month-old Maltese puppy has glaucoma, a serious condition that can lead to permanent vision loss. We already had an appointment scheduled for May 18, but when his second eye became inflamed, I brought him in immediately because of the urgency of the situation.

I was told this was considered an emergency, yet the response from the front desk was cold, dismissive, and lacked professionalism and compassion. At no point did I feel that the seriousness of my dog’s condition was treated appropriately.

As an existing client who has already invested significant time and money into my dog’s treatment, I expected much better communication, empathy, and urgency from the administrative staff.

I hope the clinic takes this feedback seriously and improves the way urgent cases and concerned pet owners are treated.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

The doctors and staff at Animal Eye Guys are truly excellent…knowledgeable, compassionate, and clearly dedicated to the animals they treat. Unfortunately, the wait times are consistently very long, which can be frustrating and stressful for both pets and owners. If the scheduling and flow were improved, this practice would be outstanding (5 stars).

My trouble is that they don’t update on Google that this location is not open on Wednesday’s and Thursday’s. It was really difficult to get through to anyone at all of their Sth Florida locations - after multiple tries, Fort Lauderdale lady picked up and told me they are short staffed and they rotate vets. Bird Rd location will be closed on Friday.
I needed an urgent appointment but they were not able to accommodate us, the lady on the phone expressed zero concern for how serious my dog’s eye problem is (happened very fast, she’s only a 4lb Yorkie).
Given that they have 5 locations, and I was willing to drive up to any - needles to say I was disappointed.
I called around and Dr Tucci in Homestead was the only one that understood the problem and she’s making room for us tomorrow at 8am. It’s a long drive from Miami Beach - but we are going there with a grateful heart

My dog had a burst cataracts and glaucoma, her eye was is extremely bad shape. We took her to the “eye vet specialist” and they charged us $600+ for medication and some basic tests to diagnose the issue and told us to come back a week later. a week later it’s SIGNIFICANTLY WORSE, im freaking out and she definitely looks like she needs the eye removed. i pay another $300+ at the follow up appointment just for MORE medications that’s don’t seem to be doing anything to help and are told to COME BACK IN 8 DAYS FOR SURGERY. next day her eye is terrible, we take her to another vet and they had it removed the same day and we paid $1000 less than what animal eye guys told us we’d be paying with them. please find another vet! these people do not care about your dog they care about their profit and selling useless medication. if we d have waited a week to bring her back, she could have died of a spread infection.

Animal Eye Guys helped my Baby when she had an eye injury. They even loaned me a pet carrier after no charge to bring her back and forth for follow up. Wonderful staff from the receptionist to the Doctors.

I want to publicly thank this clinic, which works with love and commitment… towards professionalism.

(About five months ago, my cat had surgery for a corneal sequestration at a different clinic, where she did not recover. Her problem persisted, and I received no answers or solutions, so I looked for another option.)

That's how I came to Animal Eye Guys, where from the very first visit, the quality, understanding, and excellent care were 100%. I explained the entire process at the previous clinic and everything my cat had gone through. They treated me wonderfully, with empathy, understanding my situation and explaining the next steps in detail… they operated on my cat again in her affected eye, and today, three months later, her recovery has been excellent. They not only saved her eye 👁️✅, but they also restored her quality of life ❤️‍🩹. What a fantastic team of professionals they are 👌🏻! I am so grateful… may life bring them abundant health and well-being 🙌✨ (especially Dr. Martínez 👩🏻‍⚕️ and the assistant who handled my case from the beginning, Dany 👩‍💻). Thank you so much, Pompón 🐾🐈
